text: Progress on the PropLine Bet button: the engine only matched PropLine lines against the scan's shown list, so any line Vigilant priced but didn't list had no Bet button. It now matches against every line the scan priced; that takes effect when the engine next restarts (it hands over on its own every ~6 h). Lines Vigilant never priced at all (no fair of its own) still won't have one: next I'll build the bet from Novig's own market plus PropLine's fair, then wire PropLine grading/CLV into the engine.
